{{Top|leg}}
The '''Trinith system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. This system was the original home of the [[Trinthan prowler]], with the feline predator eventually being [[Reproduction/Legends|bred]] across the galaxy due to its prowess with hunting and tracking. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] would later ban the breeding of the [[Species/Legends|species]], and the system's native predator could be found across a number of worlds, including [[Quesh]] as a result of being released into the wild.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Trinthan Prowler}}</ref>
